name: Mitten Extracts Moonrocks | Passion Orange Guava
description: Bright tropical flavors shine in Passion Orange Guava Moon Rocks, combining citrusy orange, tangy passionfruit, and sweet guava notes. This potent blend of infused flower and kief delivers a juicy, flavorful smoke with serious kick.
